Gifty snow globe

The real Gifty screens, rebuilt from the Figma frames. A 7-second celebration plays where it fits: when you pick an occasion (S03) and when the recipient views and opens the gift (R02, R03). Then it settles and stays still. Touch only: drag to tilt, tap to pop.

Occasion
Celebration
Look

Reduce motion shows the still version: a quiet scatter that doesn't move. It also follows the phone's own setting.

Physics
Moves act on a running celebration and keep it going for a moment.
Flow
Screen

Each celebration plays for 7 seconds: over the whole screen on S03 and over the hero photo on R02 and R03. Floaters drift out the top; everything else bounces softly and settles into a pile on the floor.
